rationale: All six findings from code-review-final.json are resolved and independently verified against the current source, not just against the fix-up diff. The critical one (CR-001) is confirmed gone with two non-tautological tests that fail against the pre-fix code, and the CR-004 path it interacted with — a declared component absent from YAML — still resolves, because _from_override_alone supplies enabled=False on its own. No new critical or major issue was introduced by the fix-up. Two sub-major observations were raised and handled: reset_setting reloaded the snapshot even on a no-op reset (a regression introduced by the CR-002 fix; now skipped when nothing was deleted), and OverrideCache.invalidate() is production-dead, called only by test fixtures — kept deliberately as the cache's full-reset API, with a docstring saying why the write path does not use it. Verification: make ruff clean, make license-check clean, and the non-enterprise suite is at full parity with main (an empty diff of FAILED lists). The remaining local failures — 38 modules that cannot be collected and the enterprise MCP auth set — are environmental and identical on main.
